senses.zh_definition: 若用作专有名词，Bianca 为女性名字，可音译作“比安卡”；现有材料不足以确认输入项在原语料中的具体所指。
senses.en_definition: When used as a proper noun, Bianca is a feminine given name; the intended referent is unspecified.
senses.ms_definition: Jika digunakan sebagai nama khas, Bianca ialah nama peribadi perempuan; rujukan khusus dalam data asal belum dikenal pasti.

etymology.historical_story: If the token represents the personal name Bianca, its Italian background connects it with bianca, the feminine form of bianco, meaning white. Treccani discusses the name through associations with brightness and purity. This explains a possible name origin, not a Malay common-word meaning, and does not identify which person or entity the original token denotes. See [Treccani](https://emporium.treccani.it/product/tonki-bianca/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Bianca 放进通讯录：记成一个人的名字“比安卡”，不要记成马来语的“白色”；马来语“白色”是 putih。
